title: He Had A Master Key. I Had An AirTag.
script: For three weeks straight, packages kept vanishing from our apartment lobby the same afternoon they arrived, always right after the delivery notification ping. I ordered a completely unremarkable box, just packing peanuts and a hidden AirTag zip-tied to the bottom, and left it on the counter with everyone else's mail. It disappeared by four o'clock, same as always. The tracker sat still for two hours in a unit on the third floor, then moved to the building's own maintenance closet at six, exactly when the night shift clocked in. I forwarded the location history straight to the property manager instead of confronting anyone myself. Turned out the guy with a master key to every door in the building had been running this for months, selling whatever looked expensive on a resale app under a fake name. He lost the job, the key, and is now paying back eleven other tenants through a small claims judgment nobody expected to actually collect.
